mina: quick repro on staging: streaming -> toolcall -> client-side truncate -> resume via a different router. customer saw two confirmed charges.

ashwin: can you paste the sanitized trace + ledger rows?

mina: ```STREAM id=cli-312 model=gpt-x seq=0
CHUNK seq=1 tokens=34 prefix=\"Order #\"
TOOLCALL id=tc-9 start
CLIENT_TRUNCATE reason=network_drop
LEDGER provisional tokens=34 session=cli-312
RESUME via router=ap-south-1 session=cli-312-1
CHUNK seq=1 tokens=34 prefix=\"Order #\"
LEDGER confirmed tokens=34 session=cli-312-1```

lorna: same pattern we've seen. router that handled resume didn't see provisional tombstone and wrote a new confirmed row.

sara: two thoughts: (1) add a continuity_token on provisional writes and have routers forward it on resume so confirm can attach-by-token. (2) prefix_fingerprint collisions could bite fuzzy-matchers; need fingerprint length and salt.

ashwin: on (2) we currently propose 8 bytes (64 bits). collisions are possible but extremely rare. If we detect collision we should emit an anomaly and fall back to no-dedupe. Also add customer-scoped salt so fingerprints aren't global.

lorna: +1. UX: Console should show provisional rows with a yellow badge and allow support to mark \"dispute\" which triggers refund workflow. Also a canary toggle \"enable provisional-attach\" for support-only.

pete: DB plan: provisional table adds columns continuity_token (uuid), prefix_fp (fixed64), created_at, tokens, attached_by. Confirm path: if continuity_token header present -> txn: SELECT FOR UPDATE provisional WHERE continuity_token = X AND attached_by IS NULL; if found -> attach and mark attached_by; else fallback to prefix_fp match within window W. Use small window (30s).

sara: pseudocode for fuzzy match: ```candidates = provisional_idx.lookup(customer, prefix_fp, since=now()-W) for c in candidates: if confirmed_tokens <= c.tokens * 1.08: attach(c) return true emit('unmatched_confirm', ...)```

ashwin: note the 1.08 tolerance to handle slight off-by-one or tokenization differences. We must be conservative to avoid underbilling.

mina: telemetry: provisional.pending.count, provisional.attach.rate, prefix_fp_collision.count, unmatched_confirm.count. Make a dashboard with those and top customers affected.

lorna: alerting: page eng-platform on-call if unmatched_confirm > 4/min for 15m or prefix_fp_collision > 0 for > 5m. Rate-limit pages for noisy tenants.

pete: implementation caveat: SELECT FOR UPDATE can create hotspots. Optimize by trying in-memory local cache fast-path: router that authored provisional keeps continuity_token locally for TTL and will short-circuit attach without DB hit if it receives resume. But still need DB txn fallback for cross-router resumes.

sara: console change: add \"Billing (Probe)\" mode that shows reconciled totals (provisional-aware) only to support; do not change invoices until we validate. Also add trace links on provisional rows.

mina: rollout plan: feature-flag continuity_token attach + prefix_fp match. Canary 0.5% traffic in one region for 48h. Watch provisional.attach.rate and unmatched_confirm. If metrics look good, ramp to 10% then global.

billing-bot: ticket BILL-4110 created: \"Provisional attach + prefix_fingerprint collision handling\" assigned: billing, eng-platform, console.

ops-bot: scheduled canary: provisional-attach-flag -> 2025-01-15T08:00:00Z -> 0.5% traffic (ap-south).

ashwin: I'll PR small proto change to streaming: add fixed64 prefix_fp and optional string continuity_token header. lorna will mock console UI. pete will add DB txn + tests. sara will add metrics and runbook.

mina: thanks all. please add any customer escalations here. if someone hits live double-charge case, DM me and we'll triage refunds. :heart:
